summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style PDMR dealing notification (the US-equivalent of a Form 4 insider transaction report) dated August 20, 2026. CEO Tadeu Marroco transferred 40,645 ordinary shares of 25p each (ISIN GB0002875804) from his sole account into a joint account with person closely associated Luciana Franco Do Amaral for nil consideration on 2026-08-19, outside a trading venue. No change in beneficial ownership or economic interest; no board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or deal terms. Watch for routine PDMR reporting, not a special situation.
